description: This file defines the 'CustomerOptionValueDescription' entity class which extends 'Description' and is mapped to the 'CUSTOMER_OPT_VAL_DESCRIPTION' database table. It represents a description associated with a customer option value, including a relationship to 'CustomerOptionValue'.

classes.name: CustomerOptionValueDescription
classes.description: Entity class representing descriptions for customer option values, with mapping to database schema and a relationship to 'CustomerOptionValue'.
